director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket runs jaise place karenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan
Haan, Riya—cricket pasand hai, badhiya. Socho pitch ko 4 equal parts mein baanta; ball 1 part aage ho toh fraction kya hoga? At end Golu ko sikhaogi.
step by step samjhao
Haan Riya, dheere chalte hain. 0 se 1 tak equal gaps banao. 2/5 ke liye kitne equal gaps honge?
chhota bolo
Theek hai, Riya—ab chhote steps. 0 se 1 tak 5 equal gaps banao; 2/5 kitne gaps aage hoga?
pehle picture dikhao
Riya, picture ko words mein dekho: 0 se 1 ke beech 5 barabar steps hain; 2/5 second step par hai. Kahan hoga?
pata nahi
Koi baat nahi, Riya. 2/5, 0 se do steps aage hota hai. Ab number line par second mark dikhao.
kuch aur baat karte hain
Haan Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karni hai, chhote words mein batao; phir isi point par lautenge.
cricket ke baare mein
Cricket mein fractions bhi kaam aate hain—jaise 5 balls mein 2 runs: 2/5. Tum batting pasand karti ho ya bowling?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: hindi mein batao
क्रिकेट में अंश ऐसे समझो: 5 गेंदों में 2 रन यानी 2/5। तुम बल्लेबाज़ी पसंद करती हो या गेंदबाज़ी?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Theek hai, Riya—pehle tum khud try karo. Bharo: 2/5, middle se pehle hai ya baad?

director.text: bye
Theek hai, Riya—tum rukna chahti ho. Aage badhein, chhota break lein, ya aaj ke liye ruk jaayein?
